def load_npz(path, max_bytes: int = 8_000_000) -> dict:
    """Pickle-free NPZ loader with size limits (trajectories come from the agent)."""
    path = Path(path)
    if path.stat().st_size > max_bytes:
        raise ValueError("archive too large")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        infos = archive.infolist()
        if len(infos) > 64 or sum(i.file_size for i in infos) > 8 * max_bytes:
            raise ValueError("expanded archive too large")
        if any(not i.filename.endswith(".npy") for i in infos):
            raise ValueError("expected .npy members only")
    with np.load(path, allow_pickle=False) as data:
        return {k: data[k].copy() for k in data.files}

+    gid = m.site("gripper0_right_grip_site").id
+    rootid = m.body("robot0_base").id
+    micro = s.env.microwave
+
+    def status(label):
+        p = d.site_xpos[gid].copy()
+        b = d.geom_xpos[bid].copy()
+        print(label, len(s.actions), "grip", np.round(p, 4), "err", np.round(b-p, 4),
+              "on", micro.get_state()["turned_on"], "door", round(micro.get_door_state(s.env)["door"], 4),
+              "contact", s.env.check_contact(s.env.robots[0].gripper["right"], "microwave_front_group_start_button"),
+              "success", s.check()["success"], flush=True)
+
+    def step_to(target, max_steps=100, tol=0.012, grip=1.0):
+        for i in range(max_steps):
+            err = np.asarray(target) - d.site_xpos[gid]
+            if np.linalg.norm(err) < tol:
+                break
+            R = d.xmat[rootid].reshape(3, 3)
+            a = np.zeros(12)
+            a[:3] = np.clip((R.T @ err) / 0.05 * 0.7, -0.75, 0.75)
+            a[6] = grip
+            a[11] = -1
+            s.step(a)
+            if i % 10 == 0:
+                status("move")
+        status("end_move")
+
+    status("start")
+    for i in range(10):
+        a = np.zeros(12); a[6] = 1; a[11] = -1; s.step(a)

+    status("final")
